## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 1998 invitations during the reporting period. Attendance totalled 1247, giving an attendance rate of 62.4 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of the response to the invitation activity and indicate the proportion of invited people who attended. Attendance was recorded against the invitation total, with no adjustment to the reported figures.

The outreach approach was maintained within the available arrangements. Van days were retained where roads allowed, supporting delivery of the activity in locations that could be reached safely. This arrangement formed part of the overall invitation and attendance activity.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 1693 invitees. This provided a further channel for communicating with people included in the invitation activity. Reminders were recorded as 0, and no additional reminder activity is reported.

The report was prepared by G. Evans. The figures for invitations, attendance, SMS contact and reminders are presented as recorded for the period.
